notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Rulers!

We are thrilled to finally release this important update for Lakeburg Legacies! With Patch 1.1, customize your villagers, change their names, upgrade your regular save to the next duration up until Endless Mode, look into the Castle expansion and so much more! 

Read all the details below:
[list]
[*] Villager customization
[*] Multiple saves
[*] Castle expansion
[*] New relationships
[*] Dating UX improvements
[*] Death feedback
[*] New events
[*] Congenital traits
[*] Bug fixes
[*] QoL
[*] Balancing
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/e2f56ed4a883dda3c1814dccc8ab920f2250dbbe.png[/img]

[h2]Villager customization[/h2]

Certainly one of the most anticipated features: villager customization is now available!

You can now [b]edit your villagers' portraits[/b]: hair, eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, beard, outfit, hair colour, eye colour and skin colour.

A [b]brand-new renaming option[/b] will let you rename them into whatever you like (or pick one of the newly-added names and first names).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/4942068ca480c2df54ee68c2437c6397be9c6c14.gif[/img]
Additionally, there are now a few more options to pick from when selecting a hair or eye colour for your villager!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/fe7a817f7ca0d13bbc37a9dc7d7dae055dc49045.gif[/img]

[h2]Multiple saves[/h2]

It is now possible to have [b]up to 5 different saves[/b] at the same time. This will make it easier to try different game styles and durations and find out which suits you best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/021715125787552ac1dadac58b840b9753e2f004.png[/img]
[h2]Castle expansion[/h2]

The Castle has been entirely revamped, and now has [b]two new buildings[/b].
[list]
[*] The [b]Treasury [/b]is the new place where you can manage your village’s taxes
[*] The [b]Chancellery [/b]is where you can manage your villagers’ satisfaction, depending on their class
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/827229db46d3e7102cf0d23a5ab38538f3f89ad2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/b11cd7d27a232921bdb0a9c7cf983f8e86735117.png[/img]
[h2]New relationships[/h2]

Villagers will now [b]automatically[/b] share a relationship with their family and mentor or student. 

Memorable relationships will help you keep track of who used to be part of your villager's life before their relationship faded. Indeed, relationships now evolve if the situation between two villagers changes. For example, a worker can keep a friendly relationship with a former student, if their mentoring relationship was good enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/ffe0e39ca5de8f17c419f12e8bf86d0423e69849.png[/img]
To better understand the reason why the relationship between two villagers is evolving in one way or another, their [b]Affinity level[/b] is now directly displayed on their portrait in the Relationships tab of the character sheet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/ef2e86d08ecda43e824b908d5a65d6629119a4ca.png[/img]
[h2]Dating UX improvements[/h2]

We’ve heard your complaints about the dating system, and have tried to make it smoother to use. Now, when you select a suitor, you can either [b]go on dates as you usually do or spend Hearts[/b] to have Tindra marry you immediately.

Furthermore, we’ve made the [i][b]“Ask Tindra”[/b][/i] area clearer: it now explicitly displays whether a topic is liked or disliked by the suitor. When you click the “Ask Tindra” button, only topics pertaining to the current date will be revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/c6cd8fa5ae684f0ae4ff8493a96a0a9c6c905739.png[/img]
[h2]Death feedback[/h2]

When a villager dies, they now keep their work clothes, and their tooltip displays their last job. This should make it easier to identify what building now lacks a worker.

New death events will also provide information about the main cause of death when a villager dies. You will now know what can be improved so this tragedy doesn’t repeat itself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/b066c34943694eecda8d61ed8c8fba9e8fca8934.png[/img]
[h2]New events[/h2]

You can now encounter [b]20 new events[/b] during your playthrough, in addition to the death ones!
Some of them affect the new satisfaction system, while others allow young villagers to explore new work aspirations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/d2ee9c7e94caf1a656469e86762cedb01ab2560b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/a92fa25a53d8ef451703daecdb140e9b7fec85e2.png[/img]
[h2]Congenital traits[/h2]

This improvement should satisfy those of you who are interested in the genetics part of the game!

[b]Congenital traits[/b] (that are passed from parents to children) are now upgradable. If two parents share a similar congenital trait, then their children have a chance of inheriting said trait from both parents, upgrading it to the next level. Of course, this will work with positive traits, but also with negative ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/f84129043bb9dc575fedb28632d5906cdccc4b63.png[/img]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where villagers sharing a strong friendship or enmity relationship would lose their Affinity bonus or malus after getting married together.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Couple in danger” feedback for the Royal family appeared on the Houses button instead of the Royal quarters building.
[*] Fixed a bug that made some traits give a malus on service gauges instead of a bonus.
[*] The experience gain bonus given by aspiration traits now increases along the trait’s level.
[*] Fixed a bug that made adults working in a building that matched their aspiration trait have no experience gain bonus.
[*] Fixed a bug where an incorrect log about trait distribution could appear in the Village’s journal.
[*] Fixed a bug where only villagers from the “Necessary actions” filter appeared in the Villagers menu, even though said filter was deactivated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mentoring gauge kept progressing even though the student had a higher skill level than their mentor.
[*] Improved smaller tooltips’ readability.
[*] Fixed a refresh issue with the Villagers menu that made minors stay in their family box after their caretakers die even though they’re now homeless and should appear as Orphans.
[*] Fixed a bug where empty tooltips appeared in some rare cases during events.
[*] Fixed an issue where some texts would not change when switching to another language.
[*] Fixed an issue where the royal family could appear in events as if they were commoners.
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings appeared on trees on the village map after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a bug where service gauge maluses were displayed incorrectly in illicit buildings.
[*] Fixed a bug where feedback on the Recruitment and Barter buttons wasn’t displayed anymore after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a bug where former spouses of exiled villagers were considered to be widowed.
[*] Fixed a miscalculation issue with the total amount of taxes (compared to the amount of taxes brought by each class).
[*] Fixed a miscalculation issue with the total amount of Gold earned each year.
[*] Fixed a miscalculation issue with the total amount of Hearts earned each year from couples.
[*] Fixed an issue where closing the suitors pop-up in the Dating system would open the gender and location selection screen, instead of the villager selection screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where a single villager could have Adultery-type relationships.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tutorial box in the Dating system would hide the disliked topics of the suitor.
[*] Fixed some events’ consequences that made villagers’ relationships evolve in the wrong way.
[*] Fixed a bug where event effects were sometimes not applied.
[*] Fixed a text display issue in the Upgrades tutorial box.
[*] Fixed a bug where some villagers would perform so well at their job that their production time was a negative amount of days.
[*] Fixed a bug where placing the new King/Queen in another building slot before the end of their coronation animation would completely lock the Sovereign slot in the Castle.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Life expectancy malus from working was able to reach 0.
[*] Students who no longer have a mentor (but are still in a mentoring slot) now show up when the “Necessary actions” filter of the Villagers menu is activated.
[*] Fixed a bug that made couples split up instantly after getting married in some rare cases.
[*] Fixed a bug where the “This building has no workers” feedback would show up on illicit buildings even though they have no open slots.
[*] Fixed a miscalculation issue with the production time in service buildings.
[*] Fixed a missing outline issue on the Rodent nest building.
[/list]
[h2]QoL[/h2]

We heard your sadness when having to abandon your village and legacies after your playing time has elapsed. When you reach the finish line of your current game, [b]you will now be prompted to keep playing[/b] to the next game duration available. No more games abruptly stopped by the timer!

This way you get:
[list]
[*] 30 years → 75 years
[*] 75 years → 100 years
[*] 100 years → Endless Mode
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/fae0166f4756b6edc9d49b832e2f663952d36f35.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Options menu now displays the last time the current game was saved. A game is automatically saved at the beginning of every (in-game) year.
[*] It is now possible to skip animations by clicking.
[*] When entering a new building from the village map, the default view is now always the Workers one.
[*] The game will now automatically pause after a death event, to give time to figure out what building is now missing a worker and adjust villagers placement if necessary.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]

⚠️The Stat and Skill associated with the [b]Merchant[/b] job have been modified, so you might want to have a look at your building to make sure the villagers working there are the most efficient.

[h3]Economy[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the amount of resources produced monthly by the Farmer, Hunter and Seamster jobs. 
[*] Added a new level to the Efficiency upgrade, and updated its price.
[*] Adjusted the amount of resources offered in the Barter pop-up according to the new balancing.
[/list]
[h3]Villagers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted stats and skills of neighbours (in the Recruitment and Dating pop-ups). It should now be easier to find characters whose potential better match the current state of your village!
[*] Adjusted the amount of citizenship experience required to level up.
[*] Balanced morale: traits' effects affecting morale are no longer permanent & buildings now have a higher impact on morale.
[/list]
[h3]Couples and relationships[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the chances to have a Lustful or Romance relationship through an encounter.
[*] Adjusted the impact of liked and disliked topics on the Affinity between two characters 
[*] Adjusted the chance to share a topic with a spouse following a couple’s history event.
[/list]
Adjusted the chance of getting a good or bad couple’s history event depending on the couple’s Affinity: 
[list]
[*] Good Affinity and above now have more chances of getting a good event.
[*] Average Affinity has as much chance of getting a good event as a bad one.
[*] Bad Affinity and below have more chances of getting a bad event.
[/list]
[h3]Dating[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balanced the cost of the Ask Tindra action in the Dating pop-up.
[*] The suitors’ age has been adjusted to reduce age disparity, and age difference now impacts the Affinity between two villagers.
[/list]
[h3]Illicit buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the amount of traits distributed by the Pleasure House and Assassins’ guild buildings.
[/list]
[h3]Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] The conditions to trigger some events have been adjusted, so it’s now much easier to encounter them.
[*] The consequences of some events have been adjusted to impact class satisfaction.
[/list]
[h3]Traits[/h3]
[list]
[*] The new Frisky trait can now be obtained through events and encounters in place of the Lustful trait (now limited to the Pleasure House).
[*] The Divorced and Widowed trait don’t impact the affinity with suitors anymore. That effect has been moved to the Heartbroken trait.
[/list]
Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Play Patch 1.1 in Open Beta!
notes.notes:
Hello Rulers,

Yes, you read it right: [b]you can play the Patch 1.1 today[/b]!

The new major update of Lakeburg Legacies is [b]now available in Open Beta[/b], allowing you to try it before its official release in a few weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/be1b6d19e5ef759387c4a4a1f012bb7fb824dfb8.png[/img]

[i]Note: The Open Beta is only available in english. Patch 1.1 will be available in French, German and Simplified Chinese once it officially releases.
[/i]
But what's in this Patch 1.1? Well, good question: allow us to give you a little taste of what you can expect [b]if you play the Open Beta right now[/b]!

[h1]PATCH 1.1[/h1]

This new update is bringing a lot of new content to Lakeburg Legacies, including some much-requested features like:
[list]
[*] Villager & Name customization
[*] Castle expansion
[*] Multiple Saves
[*] New relationships
[*] Dating UX improvements
[*] Death feedback
[*] New events
[*] Congenital traits
[*] Balancing
[/list]
[h2]Villager & Name customization[/h2]

Villager customization is now available in Lakeburg Legacies! We heard your feedback and we worked on this feature as soon as we can to make it available in this major update, as it was one of our priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/a7e51739354c806f530eb77ce44e50ed2f073d5a.gif[/img]

Certainly one of the most anticipated features! You can now fully customize your villagers' portrait: from hair, to nose, beard and outfit! Also, a brand new renaming option is available to let your rename your villagers with some of the best names you may think of.

[h2]Castle expansion[/h2]

The Castle has been entirely revamped, and has now two new buildings:
[list]
[*] The [b]Treasury[/b]: a new place to manage your taxes
[*] The [b]Chancellery[/b]: a new location to manage your villagers' satisfaction, depending on their class (Peasants, Artisans, Nobles)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/827229db46d3e7102cf0d23a5ab38538f3f89ad2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/b11cd7d27a232921bdb0a9c7cf983f8e86735117.png[/img]
[h2]Multiple Saves[/h2]

It is now possible to have [b]up to 5 different Saves[/b] on Lakeburg Legacies! This will make it easier to try different game styles and durations to find out which one suits you best. Or keep your old Save just in case and start something new 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/b2e6e31da0b530f0d9beb82b07486f62bc72d7d2.png[/img]
[h2]New relationships[/h2]

Villagers will now automatically share a relationship with their family and mentor or student. 
Memorable relationships will help you keep track of who used to be part of your villager's life before their relationship faded.

[h2]Dating UX improvements[/h2]

We've heard your feedback and issues about the Dating system and we worked on making it smoother to use and improve your experience

Now, when you select a suitor, you can either go on dates as you usually do, or spend Hearts to have Tindra organize your villager's marriage immediately. This will be quicker but your newly found couple will only have a [b]minimal Affinity[/b] (1/4).

Furthermore, we’ve made the [b]“Ask Tindra”[/b] area clearer: it now explicitly displays whether a topic is liked or disliked by the suitor. When you click the “Ask Tindra” button, only topics pertaining to the current date will be revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/af19ac84660f883fedbf50a7d4d015d4a235db68.png[/img]
[h2]Death feedback[/h2]

Following your feedback, when a villager dies, they now keep their work clothes, and their tooltip displays their last job. This should make it easier to identify what building now lacks a worker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/ba27bb86ec49193577716115023c06d86830ace1.png[/img]

[b]More than 20 new death events[/b] have been added to the game and will also provide information about the main cause of death when a villager dies. You will now know what can be improved so this tragedy doesn’t repeat itself!

[h2]New events[/h2]

You can now encounter 20 new events during your playthrough, in addition to the death ones! Some of them affect the new satisfaction system, while others allow young villagers to explore new work aspirations.

In addition, the conditions to trigger events have been adjusted, so it’s now much easier to have them!

[h2]Congenital traits[/h2]

This improvement should satisfy those of you who are interested in the genetics part of the game!

[b]Congenital traits[/b] (that are passed from parents to children) are now upgradable. If two parents share a similar congenital trait, then their children have a chance of inheriting said trait from both parents, upgrading it to the next level. Of course, this will work with positive traits, but also with negative ones 😈

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

⚠️The Stat and Skill associated with the [b]Merchant job[/b] have been modified, so you might want to have a look at your building to make sure the villagers working there are the most efficient.

Adjustments have been made to the following parts of the game:
[list]
[*] Economy
[*] Events
[*] Illicit buildings
[*] Villagers
[*] Dating
[*] Relationships
[/list]
A notable change is that we have adjusted the skills and potential of characters who can join your village through the dating or recruitment systems. It should now be easier to find characters whose potential [b]better match the current state of your village[/b]!

The [b]suitors’ age has been adjusted[/b] to reduce age disparity, and age difference now impacts the Affinity between two villagers.

[h1]HOW TO JOIN THE OPEN BETA[/h1]

We believe with all this information you REALLY want to play the Patch 1.1 now, so here are the steps to follow in order to join this particular branch:
[list]
[*] Go to your game library on Steam
[*] Right click on Lakeburg Legacies
[*] Click on “Properties”
[*] Go to the “Betas” tab
[*] Select "open_beta"
[*] Update Lakeburg Legacies
[*] Enjoy 😊
[/list]
[i][b]Your current Save will 100% work on the Open Beta if you decide to keep playing it on Patch 1.1 but you will not be able to come back to default as long as Patch 1.1 is not officially released (which will be in a few weeks).[/b][/i]

Which means, to play on the Open Beta you have two options:
[list]
[*] Continue an existing Save from default
[*] Or start a brand new Save, starting directly on open_beta
[/list]
Thank you for reading!

You can join us on [url=discord.gg/ishtargames][b]Discord[/b][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ishtar_games][b]Twitter[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/ishtar_games/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] to chat with the team and other players!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.9
notes.notes:
Hello Rulers,

Here is a new update for Lakeburg Legacies! We are bringing a lot of bug fixing thanks to the reports you made both on Steam and Discord.

As you may have heard, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1584940/announcements/detail/6445266637316823835]a Patch 1.1 is planned[/url] to be released in the following weeks. This update will bring to life a lot of features based upon your requests and things we have identified internally. We cannot tell you much right now but amongst the several additions to the game, with the Patch 1.1 you'll be able to have [b]Multiple Saves[/b]!

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made taxes affect the Morale of all villagers, instead of affecting only the villagers of the selected class.
[*] Fixed several bugs making portraits get mixed up between villagers.
[*] Fixed a bug that made children sometimes get a random hair color, instead of the hair color of one of their parents.
[*] Fixed a bug that made single adults unable to have Romance-type relationships.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the total of workers tracked by the "Let's get to work!" objective go in the negatives. This bug will only be fixed for all future games, sadly current ones will still be affected.
[*] Fixed several bugs affecting the calculation of the production time, including in some cases a miscalculation of the impact of a villager's relationships on their production time.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the mentorship gauge of a youth disappear even though they could still improve their stats.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented teenagers from getting a new identity trait.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it possible to launch production in the Banquet without spending any resources.
[*] Fixed a bug that filtered villagers by "Necessary actions" even when the corresponding filter wasn't selected.
[*] The notification on the Barter button is now correctly displayed when loading a save.
[*] In the Options pop-up, the shortcut to open the Couples menu is now correctly displaying F instead of T.
[*] The House summary interface can no longer appear above the Options pop-up.
[*] Improving the Recycling upgrade now triggers a sound effect.
[*] An Aspiration tooltip no longer appears when hovering the empty Aspiration slot on a baby's character sheet.
[*] The icons for the Bothered, Disappointed and Disinherited traits now have the correct shape.
[*] Fixed the value of traits affecting the service gauges, which in some cases were giving a malus instead of a bonus, and vice versa.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs on events.
[*] Fixed some small visual issues.
[/list]
[h1]QOL[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Morale tooltip has been improved to make it easier to understand. Traits distributing Morale no longer do it on a permanent basis, but rather in a recurring way.
[*] In buildings, a new filter now allows you to directly display all villagers (employed and unemployed) at once, ranked by their ⭐ Potential for the job.
[*] Villagers working a job that fits their Aspiration's corresponding skills can now earn Morale from their Aspiration trait.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.5 + News about the 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello rulers!
for this update, we're mostly focused on bringing you a much-requested feature: shortcuts! We've also worked on the stability in the relationships and we balanced the morale and the events.

However, before we jump on to the patch notes, we have a very special announcement to make: a 1.1 update is coming... soon!

[h2]Next to come: the 1.1 Update![/h2]
For the last 3 weeks, we've been working hard to fix the most urgent issues and bugs on Lakeburg Legacies. We've also worked on the balancing of the game ang added some of the most requested features (shortcuts, endless mode).

Thanks to your precious feedback, we've identified other areas that need to be added and/or reworked. This is why we're very excited to announce that we're working on a major [b]1.1 Update for Lakeburg Legacies [/b]

Since this will require a lot of work, [u]this update will take several weeks to be released.[/u]

This also means that today's patch should be the last patch before the 1.1 Update, unless there are bugs that need to be fixed.

[h2]Patch 1.0.1.5[/h2]

[h1]SHORTCUTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] New shortcuts are available to better navigate between the game’s interfaces! You can find them in tooltips, or in the brand-new Commands tab of the Options pop-up!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/5ac373c3effa4503016572d3f6071e3d59f96792.png[/img]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The potential (stars) of villagers for certain jobs no longer evolves between the moment they appear in the Recruitment pop-up and the moment they join the village.
[*] The Morale, Work results and Traits tooltips now display values per month.
[*] Optimized textures to make the game smoother while increasing assets’ quality.
[*] It is no longer possible to meet or greet a dead villager.
[*] It is no longer possible to trigger a softlock when opening the New Game pop-up while opening the Options menu.
[*] The character sheet’s UI no longer hides the name of villagers’ personality traits.
[*] The text on the “It’s a match/fail” screen is no longer blurry.
[*] The character sheet of an unemployed villager used to show English text in the “Current occupation” box in all languages. Now the text is appropriately displayed in all supported languages.
[*] Fixed a refresh bug on the buildings construction tooltip.
[*] The “Raised by wolves” achievement can now only be obtained if a homeless child no longer has a family to live with.
[*] The “Love and hate” and "Perfection is a myth" achievements can no longer be obtained through the death of one’s partner.
[*] Fixed issues with some animations on the village map.
[*] Removed a wrong icon for the Parenthood chances stat.
[*] The notification on the Recruitment and Barter buttons is now correctly displayed when loading a save.
[*] Fixed a display issue in the Build menu when all buildings have been built.
[*] Fixed tooltips being placed incorrectly.
[*] Harmonized text size in the Options pop-up.
[*] Rounded the value of service gauges.
[*] Expert traits now also display a special feedback on jobs associated with corresponding buildings.
[*] There is no longer a double entry in the Journal when celebrating a wedding.
[*] A single villager now appears in the Single part of the villagers’ bar.
[*] An exiled villager no longer displays feedback implying that they're consuming resources from the village.
[*] Mentored children no longer affect the work ambiance.
[*] Adultery relationships now give a production bonus instead of a malus.
[*] Fixed the thresholds of the chances of having a child to match the true values.
[*] Fixed an issue that made consumed and produced resources display incorrectly above buildings on the worldmap.
[/list]

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
[h2]Morale[/h2]
[list]
[*] Morale bonuses are increased and maluses are reduced in identity traits, buildings, taxes, relationships,…
[*] The Entertained trait distributed by the Bards’ House now distributes +60 Morale at once (instead of +10 every 30 days for 120 days).
[*] The Morale maluses given by traits distributed by the Activity and Safety service gauges have been reduced by 5.
[*] Increased the bonus given by the Working Conditions upgrade.
[*] The Working Conditions upgrade now also has a third level.
[/list]

[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] Modified spawning conditions to make repeating events less likely.
[*] More events can now include Teens.
[*] Events now have a bigger impact on the game.
[*] Some events (Stray cats, The Illustrious Minstrel, Musical tastes, Pony ride, A sticky brew, Weird tastes, Drink or dare) have been simplified and now use one carac/skill test instead of two to improve player agency.
[*] For couples that break up voluntarily during an event, the Divorced and Heartbroken traits will now be distributed to one or both partners, depending on the context.
[/list]

[h2]Economy[/h2]
[list]
[*] Modified the base production value to increase production in early game for all production buildings.
[*] Reduced the slot prices in all buildings
[*] Reduced the bonus given by the Efficiency upgrade.
[*] Added passive production of Gold for all classes every 90 days:
[*] Nobles now produce 1 Prestige and 1 Gold.
[*] Artisans now produce 2 Gold.
[*] Peasants now produce 1 Heart and 1 Gold.
[*] Decreased Gold obtained through taxes: -25%
[/list]

[h2]Genetics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Villagers now have more chances to inherit physical features from both their parents.
[/list]

[h2]Couples[/h2]
[list]
[*]Married couples with a high Affinity level now have slightly less chances of triggering a positive event in the House.
[*] Married couples with a low Affinity level now have more chances of triggering a positive event in the House.
[*] The Divorced and Widowed traits are now temporary. They also now decrease the Affinity level with potential suitors and new partners for one year following the divorce or death of the ex-partner.
[/list]

[h2]Barter[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased the amount of resources exchanged for Gold in early game.
[*] Adjusted the evolution of the amount of resources asked and the amount of Gold offered.
[*] Updated the Barter table according to the new balancing.
[/list]

[h2]Encounters[/h2]
[list]
[*] The encounters algorithm has been reworked. Married villagers who share a high Affinity level with their partner now have a lot less chances of developing an Adultery relationship with another villager. They will now rather develop Friendship (66%) or Romance (33%) relationships.
[*] For other adult villagers:
[*] chances of Friendship relationships have been decreased (80% ➝ 65%).
[*] chances of Lust relationships have been increased (10% ➝ 20%).
[*] chances of Romance relationships have been increased (10% ➝ 15%).
[*] Children and babies will no longer develop relationships with random strangers.
[/list]

[h1]OTHER[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some service traits (such as Suicidal or Atheist) have been renamed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.9
notes.notes:
Hello Rulers,

New update for today with the Endless Mode moving from Experimental to Default, bug fixing and also a few more balancing changes.

[h1]ENDLESS MODE (EARLY VERSION)[/h1]

On [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1584940/view/3692439461709804014]Friday night[/url] we added a very early version of the [b]Endless Mode[/b] on the Experimental branch. Since the past few days went fine for this new game mode, we decided to move it from Experimental to Default, allowing everyone to play it.

[b]To launch your game in Endless Mode[/b], navigate through the game duration and select [b]Endless[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/bf80a102964a87a57d386ac920a64ab27c2d6ad3.gif[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:[/b] in this short amount of time, we literally just removed the time limit without changing anything to the gameplay, so don’t be expecting something fully functional! We see this as a good way to start a discussion with you to see what would this Endless Mode need the most. Also it will help us find and correct performance issues once the village gets too big (crashes are expected).

Share your feedback about the Endless Mode [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1584940/discussions/0/3809533247343394532/]here[/url].

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized a lot of textures in order to prevent some crashes: the game is now lighter and should use less RAM.
[*] Optimized fonts in order to prevent some crashes.
[*] In the mentorship tab, the feedback showing that a mentor is dead or exiled has been fixed so it doesn’t look like the villager is still there.
[*] There was an interface issue in the Build menu once all buildings were built. This issue has been fixed.
[*] Illicit buildings now display a visual feedback when they open a new slot.
[/list]
[h1]QoL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Arrows have been added to buildings to make it easier to switch from one to the other. The corresponding shortcut has also been made clearer.
[*] The access to the Neighbours popup has been divided into two buttons: Recruitment and Barter. This should make it easier to find Ernesto the merchant and his trusty llama!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/98ae2c84228bc7446eaacca7bf0961478ee67035.gif[/img]

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
[h2]Genetics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Babies born from same-gender couples will now inherit physical features and congenital traits from their parents, in the same way that babies born from different-gender couples do. Storks don’t discriminate anymore!
[/list]
This is a first step: we’re planning to keep on solving issues with the genetics system in the very near future!

[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] Homeless child: This event now triggers more often. This should greatly decrease the amount of homeless children in the streets of Lakeburg!
[*] Late harvests: Married villagers will no longer take part in this event, as one of the choices could make their marriage break without it being the main focus of the event.
[/list]
[i]Note: Due to our efforts to reduce RAM usage and crashes, some backgrounds currently have a lower quality. This will be fixed later on as we keep on investigating.[/i]

Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Lakeburg Legacies Release Date is moving to Summer 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Rulers,

The [url=the last Spell sur Steam]demo of Lakeburg Legacies[/url] has been out for a few months now, and we are blown away by your enthusiasm, comments and excitement. Each day, we are more and more surprised by the love you have for our game and [b]we cannot thank you enough for your support, feedback and ideas[/b] shared on our socials and [url=discord.gg/ishtargames]Discord[/url].

[h2]From Spring to Summer 2023[/h2]

Lakeburg Legacies was planned to be released in Spring 2023 on PC, and if the past tense is being used here, it is because something has changed: [b]we need a little bit more time to polish and make the best possible version of Lakeburg Legacies[/b].

The demo taught us that you ARE loving the game, even though it is a [b]small part of Lakeburg Legacies[/b] and you are slowly but surely building its success with us. We've seen it a few weeks ago: [url=https://twitter.com/ishtar_games/status/1638571248916594691][b]we passed the important threshold of 100 000 wishlists![/b][/url]

We want to release the Lakeburg Legacies that will captivate you and let you pour dozens or even hundreds of hours into, [b]just like some of you did with the demo[/b] (yes, we've seen your screenshots!).

To accomplish this, [b]we are slightly shifting the release date of Lakeburg Legacies from Spring 2023 to Summer 2023[/b]. In the coming months, we will have a lot of things to show you and we cannot wait to see your reactions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723341/98e900c822d1315ac878df311cf5e9b9b228bfe7.png[/img]
